सम्-√ उभ् P. -उभ्नाति, -उनप्ति (impf. -उनप्), to confine, shut up, keep closed, cover up, RV.

m: स-मुख mfn. ‘mouthy’, talkative, loquacious, eloquent, L.
a: समुख — a. 1 Talkative, garrulous. --2 Eloquent.
समुंद् — {c7c} P. To moisten thoroughly, water, wet.
समुंदनं — 1 Moistening. --2 Wetness, moisture.

m: स-मुञ्ज mfn. having Muñja grass, Gobh.
furnished with reeds, MānGṛ.
सम्-उब्ध mfn. confined, closed, covered up, ib.

सम्-उब्जित mfn. covered over, closed up, AV.
सम्-√ उच् P. -उच्यति (pf. -उवोच), to delight in, like to be together with (instr.), RV.

सम्-उच्-छल् (-उद्-√ शल्) only in -उच्छलत् and -उच्छलित (mfn.) jerking or jerked up, Cat.

v: tri॰ samyak + ucCvalitam sam + ud + Sval--kta vA । samantAt vistIrRe (CayalApi) “samucCvAlatabiBramA gatiH” kAvyapra॰ ।

a: समुच्छेदः — Complete destruction, extermination, eradication.

सम्-उच्-√ छिद् (-उद्-√ छिद्) P. Ā. -छिनत्ति, -छिन्त्ते, to cut up or off completely, tear up, uproot, exterminate, destroy utterly, MBh.; Pañcat.
a: समुच्छिद् — {c7c} P. To destroy completely, cut up, exterminate, eradicate.

m: सम्-उच्छिन्न mfn. torn up, uprooted, eradicated, utterly destroyed, lost, Sūryas.
सम्-उच्छिन्न—वासन mfn. one whose dress is torn off (or ‘one whose delusion is completely removed’), Prab.
सम्-उच्छित्ति f. cutting off completely, utter destruction, Divyāv.
सम्-˚उच्छ्राय m. rising, increase, growth, height, high degree, Suśr.; Dhātup.
a: समुच्छ्रायः — Elevation, height.

s: puM, (saM + ut + Sri + ac .) viroDaH । utseDaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 9 । 20 । “kanakayUpasamucCrayaSoBino vitamasA tamasAsarayUtawAH ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + vad + Sri--ac GaY vA । 1 atyunnatO 2 viroDe 3 utseDe ca medi॰ ।
m: सम्-उच्छ्रय mfn. who or what rises or grows up (सर्वम् ˚रयम् = ‘all living beings’), R.
सम्-उच्छ्रय m. raising aloft, erection, elevation, MBh.; SaddhP.
height, length, Hariv.; Ragh.; VarBṛS.
an eminence, hill, mountain, MBh.
rising, rise, exaltation, high position, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
increase, growth, high degree, Hariv.; Suśr.
stimulation, Suśr.
accumulation, multitude, Kāraṇḍ.
(with, Buddh.) birth (according to others, ‘body’), Divyāv.
opposition, enmity, L.
a: समुच्छ्रयः — 1 Elevation, height. --2 Opposition, enmity.

k.v: सङ्घाते सन्निवेशे च संस्त्यायः प्रणयास्त्वमी। विस्रम्भयाञ्चाप्रेमाणो विरोधेऽपि समुच्छ्रयः॥

m: सम्-उच्-छ्रि (-उद्-√ श्रि) P. Ā. -छ्रयति, ˚ते (only 3. pl. pf. -उच्-छिश्रियुः), to raise well up, raise aloft, erect, elevate, Bhaṭṭ.
a: समुच्छ्रि — {c1c} U. To raise up, erect, elevate.

m: सम्-उच्छ्रित mfn. well raised or elevated, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
surging, high, ib.
exalted, powerful, Suśr.
सम्-उच्छ्रित—भुज mf(आ)n. having arms well raised, ib.
सम्-उच्छ्रित—ध्वज-वत् mfn. having flags hoisted (in it, said of a town), R.
सम्-˚उच्छ्रिति f. augmentation, increase, growth, Suśr.
सम्-उच्-छुष् (-उद्-√ शुष्) P. -छुष्यति, to be or become completely dried up, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-˚उच्छ्वास m. heavy expiration, sighing, ib.
सम्-˚उच्छ्वासित mfn. raised, elevated, swelled, Kum. iii, 38 (= वि-श्लेषित, Sch.)
सम्-उच्-छ्वस् (-उद्-√ श्वस्) P. -छ्वसिति, or -छ्वसति, to breathe well or regularly, Suśr.; to breathe again, recover, revive, Kathās.; to spring or sprout up, Śiś. : Caus. See सम्-उच्छ्वासित.

v: tri॰ sam + ud + Svasa--kta । 1 samyagucCvAsayukte 2 pratyujjIvite ca ।
m: सम्-उच्छ्वसित mfn. breathed or sighed deeply (n. used impersonally), Amar.
सम्-उच्छ्वसित n. breathing, Kād.
a heavy or deep sigh, W.
a: समुच्छ्वसितं, --समुच्छ्वासः — Sighing deeply, a heavy or deep sigh.

m: सम्-उच्चार m. utterance, pronunciation, KāśīKh.
सम्-˚उच्चारण n. (fr. Caus.) simultaneous utterance or pronunciation, Pāṇ. i, 3, 48.
सम्-उच्च mfn. lofty, high, KāśīKh.
सम्-उच्-√ चल् (-उद्-√ चल्) P. -चलति, to start or set out together, Daś.; Mālatīm.

सम्-उच्-√ चर् (-उद्-√ चर्) P. -चरति, to go out together, Nir.; to go up, be borne upwards, ascend, MW.; to utter, pronounce, repeat, HPariś. : Caus. -चारयति, to utter sounds together, talk together, MW.

v: pu॰ sam + ud + cara--ap GaY vA । samyaguccAraRe 2 samyaktyAge ca ।
m: सम्-उच्चर m. going or coming forth together, MW.
ascending, flying upwards, ib.
traversing, ib.
a: समुच्चरः — 1 Ascending. --2 Traversing, crossing.

m: सम्-उच्च˚यालंकार m. the above rhetorical figure

s: puM, (saM + ut + ci + ac .) samAhAraH । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 16 ॥ yaTA, -- “rASO dvayorbahUnAYca samAhAraH samuccayaH ॥” iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, kumAre । 1 । 49 । “sarvvopamAdravyasamuccayena yaTApradeSaM viniveSitena । sA nirmmitA viSvasfjA prayantAdekasTasOndaryyadidfkzayeva ॥”)

m: सम्-उच्चय m. aggregation, accumulation, collection, assemblage, multitude, Kāv.
totality, aggregate, Kāv.; Suśr.; Kathās.
conjunction of words or sentences (as by the particle च, ‘and’), conjunctive sense (opp. to the disjunctive वा, ‘or’), Nir.; GṛS.; Suśr. &c.
(in rhet.) a figure of speech (the joining together of two or more independent things associated in idea with some common action), Sāh.; Kpr.
a: समुच्चयः — 1 Collection, assemblage, aggregation, mass, multitude. --2 Conjunction of words or sentences; see च. --3 A figure of speech; K. P. 10. (Kārikās 115 and 116), (it consists in joining together two or more things, independent of each other, but connected in idea with reference to some common action).

k.v: अपहारस्त्वपचयः समाहारः समुच्चयः। प्रत्याहार उपादानं विहारस्तु परिक्रमः॥

m: सम्-˚उच्चयन n. collecting or heaping together, Pat.
सम्-उच्च˚योपमा f. a simile containing the above, Kāvyād. ii, 21.
सम्-उच्चेतव्य mfn. to be taken together or collectively (i.e. one equally with the other), Nyāyam.
सम्-˚उच्चेय mfn. id., ib., Sch.

सम्-उच्-√ चि (-उद्- √ 1. चि) P. Ā. -चिनोति, -चिनुते (ind.p. -चयित्वा), to heap or pile up together, accumulate, add together, MBh.; to collect, gather, arrange in order, Baudh. : Desid. See सम्-उच्चिचीषा.
a: समुच्चि — {c5c} U. 1 To collect, heap up. --2 To arrange, array in order.

m: सम्-उच्चिचीषा f. (fr. Desid.) the wish to accumulate or collect or combine or add together, VS., Sch.
सम्-उच्चिती-कृत mfn., id., Naiṣ.

v: tri॰ sam + ud + ci--kta । kftasamuccaye “samuccitaPalakAmanAnAmi” ti viDiKarUpe gadADaraH ।
m: सम्-उच्चित mfn. accumulated, collected together, regularly arranged, Kār. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 10 (˚ती-कृत mfn. id., Naiṣ.)

s: tri, (samyagucitaH । upayuktaH । yaTA, -- “vadAmasta kiMvA janani vayamuccErjaqaDiyo na DAtA nApISo harirapi na te vetti paramam । taTApi tvadBaktirmuKarayati cAsmAkamasite tadetat kzantavyaM na Kalu paSurozaH samucitaH ॥” iti tantrasAraDftaSyAmAstotram ॥
v: tri॰ sam + uca--kta । samyag upayukte samaYjase ।
m: सम्-उचित mfn. delighted in, liked, well suited, fit, right, proper, R.; Megh.; Inscr.
accustomed or used to (gen.), Megh.
सम्-√ उद् (or उन्द्) P. -उनत्ति (ind.p. -उद्य, ‘having well moistened’), to moisten thoroughly, sprinkle all over, water, wet, PārGṛ.; Nir.
सम्-उद् accord. to some = ‘conversation’, AV. viii, 1, 15.
स-मुद् mfn. joyful, glad, Śiś.

v: pu॰ sam + ud + A--cara--GaYa । 1 aBiprAye trikA॰ । 2 samyagAcAre ca ।
m: सम्-उदाचार m. presentation, offering, entertainment (of a guest &c.), MBh.; Hariv.
proper or right practice or usage or conduct or behaviour, MBh.; R. &c.
intercourse with (instr.), MBh.
address, Hariv.; Kāv. &c.
salutation, Divyāv.
intention, purpose, design, motive, L.
सम्-उदाचार mfn. = next, BhP.
a: समुदाचारः — 1 Proper practise or usage. --2 Proper mode of address; Ś. 5. --3 Purpose, intention, design.

m: सम्-उदाचार—वत् mfn. one who conducts himself well, MBh.
सम्-˚उदाचारिन् mfn. accosting, addressing, Divyāv.
सम्-उद्-आ-√ चर् Ā. -चरते, to move or travel about (e.g. रथेन, ‘in a chariot’), Siddh.; P. -चरति, to act towards, treat, MBh.; to practise, accomplish, do, ib.; to speak to, address, Divyāv.
सम्-उदाचरित mfn. addressed, Divyāv.
सम्-उद्-आ-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to rise together, Divyāv.; to arrive at full knowledge (see next).

s: puM, (sam + ut + A + gama + GaY .) samantAjjYAnam । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥

a: समुदागमः — Full knowledge.

m: सम्-उदागत mfn. one who has attained full knowledge, excelling in (comp.), Lalit.
सम्-˚उदाहार m. (in कथास्˚) conversation, Divyāv.
सम्-उदाहरण n. declaring, uttering, W.
illustrating, illustration, ib.
a: समुदाहरणं — 1 Declaring, pronouncing. --2 Illustration.

m: सम्-उद्-आ-√ हृ P. -हरति, to utter together, pronounce, declare, Hariv.; R.; BhP.
सम्-उदाहृत mfn. talked to, addressed, Hariv.
talked about, mentioned as, named, called, ĀśvŚr.; Mn.; R. &c.
stated, declared, Yājñ.
illustrated, W.
सम्-˚उदानीत-त्व n. the being accomplished, Jātakam.
1. सम्-उद्-आ-नय m. (√ नी) bringing together, assembly, MBh.
bringing about, accomplishment, perfection, Lalit.
2. सम्-उदानय Nom. P. ˚यति, to collect, Divyāv.; to bring about, attain, ib.
सम्-˚उदानयन n. bringing near, Jātakam.
1. सम्-उद्-आ-नय—ता f. id., Divyāv.
सम्-˚उदानयितव्य mfn. to be mastered thoroughly, SaddhP.
सम्-˚उदानेतव्य mfn. to be brought near, Divyāv.
सम्-˚उदानित mfn. attained (v.l. ˚नीत), Lalit.; Divyāv.
सम्-उद्-आ-√ वह् P. -वहति, to lead or conduct out, draw or carry away, Hariv.; to draw along (said of horses), R.; to conduct home, marry, MBh.

s: puM, (sam + ut + aya + GaY .) samUhaH । yudDam । ityamaraH । 2 । 5 । 40; 2 । 8 । 106 ॥ pfzWasTAyibalam । ityajayaH ॥ samucCrayaH । iti medinI ॥
m: सम्-उदाय m. combination, collection, multitude, mass, totality, a whole, Prāt.; Kāv.; Pañcat.
(with Buddhists) = सम्-उदय, Sarvad.
a partic. Nakṣatra, VarYogay.
war, battle, L.
the rear or reserve of an army, L.
a: समुदायः — 1 A collection, multitude &c. --2 A word of more than one syllable; see समुदाय.

समुदायः स्त्रियः संयत्समित्याजिसमिद्युधः। नियुद्धं बाहुयुद्धेऽथ तुमुलं रणसङ्कुले॥

m: सम्-उदाय—प्रकरण n. N. of wk.
सम्-˚उदायिन् mfn. combining, forming an aggregate, Śaṃk.
सम्-उद्भासन n. lighting up, illuminating, Kād.
सम्-उद्-√ भू P. -भवति, to spring up from, arise, be produced, exist, Kāv.; to increase, augment, grow, Suśr.

s: tri, (sam + ut + BU + ktaH .) samutpannaH । yaTA, devImAhAtmye । “sAbravIttAn surAn suBrUrBavadBistUyate'tra kA । SarIrakozataScAsyAH samudBUtAbravIcCivA ॥”
m: सम्-उद्भूत mfn. sprung up, arisen, born, produced, derived, MBh.; R.; Pur.
existing, Pratāp.
v.l. or w.r. for सम्-उद्धूत or सम्-उद्धत, MBh.
सम्-˚उद्भूति f. arising, appearance, Sāh.
सम्-उद्भव m. (ifc. f(आ). ) existence, production, origin (ifc. either ‘arisen or produced from’ or ‘being the source of’), Mn.; MBh. &c.
coming to life again, revival, MBh.
N. of Agni at the Vratādeśa, Gṛhyās.
a: समुद्भवः — Origin, production.

m: सम्-उद्भेद m. bursting forth, appearance, development, growth, Daśar.; Sāh.; iii, 8522.
सम्-उद्-भ्रान्त mfn. (√ भ्रम्) roused up, excited, bewildered, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-उद्-धा (-उद्-√ हा) Ā. -उज्जिहीते, to rise together, come forth, appear, BhP.; to burst forth, be heard, sound, Prasannar.
सम्-उद्धार m. drawing out, extraction from (abl.), MārkP.
extrication from any danger, rescue, delivery, Śatr.
removal, destruction, Kāv.
N. of a prince (for हरि-कृष्ण-स्˚), Kṣitīś.
सम्-उद्-√ धू P. Ā. -धूनोति, -धूनुते, to shake up, raise (dust), agitate, move hither and thither, MBh.; R.; Hariv.
सम्-उद्धूत (or समुद्धुत), mfn. shaken up, agitated, moved hither and thither, ib.; hurled or thrown near, MBh.
सम्-उद्धूषर mfn. (prob.) dust-coloured, grey (= धूसर), Pañcar.

v: na॰ sam + uw + hf--lyaw । 1 uttolane kUpAderjalonnayane 2 BuktAnnasya vamane 3 unmUlane ca । karmaRi lyuw । 4 vAnte annAdO 5 sanmUlite ca amaraH ।
m: सम्-उद्धरण n. the act of drawing well out or up, extricating, raising, lifting, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
taking off or away, removal, Cat.
eradication, extirpation, W.
taking out from (as a part or share), deduction, ib.
food thrown up (from the stomach), vomit, L.
a: समुद्धरणं — 1 Upraising, lifting up. --2 Picking up. --3 Drawing or lifting out. --4 Extrication, deliverance. --5 Eradication, extirpation. --6 Taking out from (a share). --7 Food thrown up or vomited.

m: सम्-˚उद्धर्तृ mfn. one who lifts up or raises or extricates from (abl.), MBh.; MārkP.
सम्-˚उद्धर्तृ m. an uptearer, extirpator, Ragh.
a: समुद्धर्तृ — m. A deliverer, redeemer.

v: tri॰ sam + ud + hf--vfc । 1 vamanakAriRi 2 unmalayitari utTApake 4 hftadravyasya punarAdAnakarttari ca

m: सम्-उद्धर्ष m. war, battle (perhaps w.r. for सम्-उद्घर्ष), MBh.
सम्-उद्-धस्त (for -उद्-हस्त) mfn. wiped off with the hand, W.

s: tri, (sam + ut + hana + ktaH .) avinItaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 2 ॥ samudgIrRaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: सम्-उद्-धत mfn. (√ हन्) raised well up, uplifted, elevated, whirled up (as dust), flowing (as a river) high up on (comp.), heaving, swelling (as waters), towering, lofty, high, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
increased, intense, violent, R.; Jātakam.
puffed up with pride, arrogant, impudent, L.
swelling with, abounding in, full of (comp.), R.; Śiś.
w.r. for सम्-उद्-धुत and -धृत
a: समुद्धत — p. p. 1 Upraised, uplifted, elevated. --2 Excited, drawnup. --3 Puffed up with pride, proud, arrogant. --4 Ill-mannered, ill-behaved. --5 Impudent, rude.

k.v: सोन्मादस्तून्मदिष्णुः स्यादविनीतः समुद्धतः। मत्ते शौण्डोत्कटक्षीबाः कामुके कमितानुकः॥

m: सम्-उद्-धत—लाङ्गूल mfn. (an animal) whose tail is raised or cocked up (v.l. सम्-उन्-नत), Hit.
सम्-उद्-धत—तरंगिन् mfn. (a river) whose waves are heaving or swelling, MBh.
1. सम्-उद्-√ धृ (only in next).

2. सम्-उद्-धृ (-उद्-√ हृ) P. a: समुद्धृ — {c1c} U. 1 To raise or lift up. --2 To save, extricate, deliver, rescue. --3 To extract, take or draw out. --4 To pull up by the roots, root out, extirpate. --5 To extol, praise, honour.

s: tri, (sam + ut + hf + ktaH .) samutkIrRam । apanItam । iti medinI ॥ samyakprakAreRa udDftam । utTApitam । yaTA, -- “jalOGamagnA sacarAcarA DarA vizARakoWyAKilaviSvamUrttinA । samudDftA yena varAharUpiRA sa me svayamBurBagavAn prasIdatu ॥” iti pARqavagItA ॥

m: सम्-उद्धृत mfn. well raised or drawn up or uplifted &c. &c.
taken out from (as a share), deducted (˚तोद्धारे, loc. ‘if a deduction be made’), Mn. ix, 116.
a: समुद्धृत — p. p. 1 Lifted up. --2 Delivered, saved, rescued. --3 Vomited. --4 Removed. --5 Set apart, divided. --6 Seized; possessed. --7 Ill-behaved, rude.

m: सम्-उद्-धृष् (-उद्-√ हृष्) Caus. -उद्धर्षयति, to excite joyfully, gladden, delight, Kāṭh.
सम्-उद्धुर mfn. lifted up, stretched out, Caurap.
सम्-उद्-ध्वस्त mfn. (√ ध्वंस्) completely overspread, sprinkled or covered with (comp.), R.
सम्-उद्घात m. destruction, extermination, Buddh.
सम्-उद्घातिन् See विमति-स्˚, p. 979, col. 3.
सम्-उद्घाट m. taking away, removal (perhaps w.r. for ˚घात), Lalit.
सम्-उद्-√ घट् Caus. -घाटयति, to open, R.; to uncover (one's head i.e. ‘be able to show one's self in public’), Kād.
सम्-उद्-√ घृष् P. -घर्षति, to rub together, grind, pound, Prasannar.
सम्-उद्-√ ईक्ष् Ā. -ईक्षते, to look up at, look at attentively, perceive, observe, R.; Amar.; to have regard or respect for (acc.), MBh.
सम्-उद्-√ ईर् Caus. -ईरयति, to drive out, expel, MBh.; to raise (dust), MBh.; to hurl, throw, ib.; to utter, speak, declare, Kathās.
a: समुदीर् — Caus. 1 To utter, pronounce. --2 To rouse, agitate, excite, stimulate.

m: सम्-˚उदीर्ण mfn. greatly moved or agitated or excited, R.; Suśr.
सम्-˚उदीर्ण—खर mfn. agitated and sharp or pungent, Suśr.
सम्-˚उदीर्ण—मानस mfn. agitated or excited in mind, R.
सम्-उदीरण n. setting in motion or getting into motion, MārkP.
raising the voice, uttering pronouncing, reciting, W.
a: समुदीरणं — 1 Uttering, speaking, pronouncing. --2 Repeating.

m: सम्-˚उदीरित mfn. (fr. Caus.) set in motion, raised, uttered, pronounced, MBh.
सम्-उद्-√ ईष् P. -ईषति, to rise well upwards, ChUp.
सम्-उद्-√ अञ्च् P. -अञ्चति, to rise, draw up, come near, begin, Bhām.

s: tri, (samudacyate smeti । sam + ut + anca + ktaH .) udDftam । kUpAderudDftajalAdi । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 90 ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + anaca--kta । kUpAderudDftajalAdO amaraH ।
m: सम्-उदक्त mfn. lifted up, raised up, thrown up, L.
a: समुदक्त — p. p. Raised or drawn up (as water from a well).

k.v: घ्राणघ्राते दिग्धलिप्ते समुदक्तोद्धृते समे। वेष्टितं  स्याद्वलयितं संवीतं रुद्धमावृतम्.।

m: सम्-उदन्त mfn. rising above the edge, about to overflow, MaitrS.; Br.; ŚrS.
सम्-उद्-अस्त mfn. (√ 2. अस्) drawn or raised from a deep place, L.

s: klI, (sam + ut + iR + ac .) lagnam । yaTA, -- “sAmarTyaM tanu kalyate samudaye vittaM kuwumbaM tato vikrAntiM sahajaM tftIyaBavane yoDaYca saYcintayet .” ityAdi jyotistattvam ॥ zaRRAqIcakrAntargatacaturTanAqI । sA tu janmanakzatrAvaDikAzwAdaSanakzatrarUpA । tatparyyAyaH । sAmudAyikam 2 । yaTA, jyotistattve । “janmarkzaM karmma tato daSamaM sAMGAtikaM zoqaSaBam । samudayamazwAdaSaBaM vinASasaMjYaM trayoviMSam ॥ santapte sAmudAyike mitraBUtyarTasaMkzayaH ॥”

puM, (sam + ut + iR + ac .) samUhaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 5 । 40 ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 10 । 196 । “tamupAjagmatustO ca senAsamudayAnvitO । taM vijYAyEva saMbanDaM mudA duhitfvatsalO ॥”) yudDam । (yaTA, mahABArate । 6 । 113 । 44 । “droRaH pAYcAlaputtreRa samAgamya mahAraRe । mahAsamudayaM cakre SarEH sannataparvvaBiH ॥”) samudgamaH । iti medinI ॥ divasaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥
v: pu॰ sam + ud + iRa ac । 1 samUhe aBaraH 2 yudDe 3 samudgame medi॰ 4 divame Sabdara॰ । jyotizokte 5 lagne na॰ । 3 zaqnAqIcakramye janmatAravaDike azwAdaSanakzatre cakraSabde pf॰ dfSyam । GaYataH samahe yudDe pu॰ amaraH । pfzWasTasEnye ajayaH atyunnatO medi॰ ।
m: सम्-उदय m. (rarely n.) coming together, union, junction, combination, collection, assemblage, multitude, aggregation, aggregate (acc. with √ कृ, ‘to collect or assemble’), MaitrUp.; MBh. &c.
(with Buddhists) the aggregate of the constituent elements or factors of any being or existence (in later times equivalent to ‘existence’ itself), Buddh.; Sarvad.
a producing cause (e.g. दुःखस्˚ ‘the cause of suffering’), Dharmas. 22
income, revenue, Mn.; MBh.
success, prosperity, Mṛcch.
war, battle, L.
a day, L.
= उद्गम or समुद्गम, L.
rising (of the sun &c.), W.
सम्-उदय n. an auspicious moment (= लग्न), L.
a: समुदयः — 1 Ascent, rising up(of the sun). --2 Rise (in general). --3 A collection, multitude, number, heap; सामर्थ्यानामिव समुदयः संचयो वा गुणानां U. 6. 9. --4 Combination. --5 The whole. --6 Revenue. --7 Effort, exertion. --8 War, battle. --9 Day. --10 The rear of an army. --यं 1 The rising of a planet &c. --2 An auspicious moment (लग्न).

k.v: समुदायः समुदयः समवायश्चयो गणः। स्त्रियां तु संहतिर्वृन्दं निकुरम्बं कदम्बकम्.।

m: सम्-उद्-√ बन्ध् (only ind.p. -बध्य), to bind up firmly, MBh.
सम्-उद्बन्धन n. hanging up (आत्मनः, ‘one's self’), Kād.
सम्-उद्-√ बृह् P. -बृहति, to draw out together, pull out, MBh.
सम्-उद्बोध m. becoming consciousness, Sāh.
सम्-˚उद्बोधन n. (fr. Caus.) thorough rousing up, awakening (from a swoon), resuscitation, Prasannar.
सम्-उद्-√ बुध् Caus. -बोधयति, to rouse up thoroughly, awaken, animate, Nīlak.
सम्-उद्-√ दॄ Pass. -दीर्यते, to be completely rent or torn in pieces, burst asunder, MW.
सम्-उद्-√ दीप् Caus. -दीपयति, to light up, inflame, R.
सम्-उद्दण्ड mfn. uplifted (as an arm), Daś.
सम्-˚उद्देशीय See व्याधि-समुद्देशीय.

v: pu॰ samyak uddeSaH uda + diSa--GaY । samyagaBisanDO । 2 samyaguddeSe ca yaTA “vAkyapAdA jAtisamuddeSe” maYjUzA
m: सम्-उद्देश mfn. full exposition, accurate or complete description, theory, doctrine, MBh.; Sarvad.
a place, locality, abode of (gen.), MBh.; R.; Hariv.
a: समुद्देशः — 1 Fully pointing out. --2 Full description. --3 Particularising, enumeration.

m: सम्-उद्-दृप्त mfn. (√ दृप्) haughty, arrogant, R.
सम्-उद्दिधीर्षु See below.
सम्-उद्दिधीर्षु mfn. wishing to save, Cat.

सम्-उद्-√ दिश् P. -दिशति (ind.p. दिश्य, q.v.), to point out or indicate fully, mention at full, state, declare, communicate, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to designate as, name (two acc.), VarBṛS.; to enter into discussion with (instr.), AitĀr.; to refer or relate to (see next).
सम्-उद्दिश्य ind. having fully pointed out &c.
(with acc.) with reference or regard to, on account or in behalf or in honour of, at, against, towards, to, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

v: tri॰ samyak uddizwam ud + diSa--kta । samyaguddeSavizaye padArTe tatsamuddizwaM karmeti” sakziptasAraH ।
m: सम्-˚उद्दिष्ट mfn. fully pointed out or declared or indicated, shown, explained, enumerated, particularized, Mn.; MBh. &c.
designated as, named, called, VarBṛS.
सम्-उद्-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति, to run forth together, escape together, ŚBr.
सम्-उद्-√ द्युत् Ā. -द्योतते, to blaze up, shine very brilliantly, Prab.
सम्-उदेत mfn. (cf. 2. सम्-उदित above) excelling in (comp.), Āpast.
possessed of all good qualities, ib.
सम्-उद्-गार m. (√ 2. गॄ) vomiting or spitting out, ejection, Hariv.

s: tri, vamitaH । uttolitaH । kaTitaH । samutpUrvvagFDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + gf--kta । 1 vamite 2 uttolate 3 kaTite ca ।
m: सम्-उद्गीर्ण mfn. vomited forth, ejected, raised
uttered, exclaimed (in these senses perhaps fr. √ 1. गॄ), L.
सम्-उद्-गीत mfn. (√ गै) sung out loud, chanted loudly, MW.
सम्-उद्-गीत n. a loud song, chant, ib.
a: समुद्गीतं — A loud song.

s: puM, (samudgacCatIti । sam + ut + gam + anyezvapIti qaH .) sampuwakaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, rAmAyaRe । 2 । 91 । 75 । “SuklAMScandanakalkAMSca samudgezvavatizWataH ॥” mudgena saha varttamAnaH .) mudgasahitaSca ॥
v: pu॰ sam + ud + gama--qa । 1 sampuwake hemaca॰ 2 saSlezakArakadArTe 3 mudgena sahite । svArTe ka । tatrEva amaraH
m: समुद्ग m. (of doubtful derivation; for सम्-उद्ग See below) the point of a bud (in अर्क-स्˚, q.v.)
a round box or casket (said to be also n.; ifc. f(आ). ), Yājñ.; VarBṛS.; Kathās.
a round form of a temple, VarBṛS.
(in rhet.) a kind of paronomasia (in which a verse or part of a verse identical in sound but different in meaning is repeated), Kāvyād. iii, 54-56
सम्-उद्ग mfn. (for समुद्ग See above) going up or rising together, W.
a: समुद्ग — a. 1 Rising, ascending. --2 Completely pervading. --3 Having a covering or lid. --4 Having beans. --द्गः 1 A covered box or casket. --2 A kind of artificial stanza; see समुद्गक below. --Comp. --यमकं (in Rhet.) making an artificial arrangement of words in such a manner as to make different parts of a stanza correspond in sound though they differ in meaning; see यमक.

s: puM, (samudga eva । svArTe kan .) sampuwakaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 139 ॥ sApUqA iti KyAte । samudgacCatIti hanajanAdgamAderiti qe samudgaH tataH svArTe kaH । sampuwati druvyeH saMSlizwo Bavati sampuwakaH puwa Si Slaze ijuNtvAt kaH tataH svArTe kaH । iti BarataH ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 38 । 47 । “BikzuH prapaYcabudDyAKyaH samudgakamupAnayat ॥”) CandoviSezaSca ॥
m: समुद्गक m. n. a round box or casket, Daś.; Ratnāv. &c.
(in rhet.) = prec. L.
a: समुद्गकः — 1 A covered box or casket; Ś. 4. --2 A kind of artificial stanza, the two halves of which exactly correspond in sound, though different in meaning; e. g. Ki. 15. 16.

k.v: समुद्गकः सम्पुटकः प्रतिग्राहः पतद्ग्रहः। प्रसाधनी कङ्कतिका पिष्टातः पटवासकः॥

m: समुद्गल See रत्न-स्˚.
सम्-उद्-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go or rise up together, come or break forth, MW.
a: समुद्गम् — {c1c} A. 1 To rise, ascend. --2 To rise together. --3 To come forth, issue, exude.

s: puM, UrdDvagatiH । utpattiH । saMpUrvvotpUrvvagamaDAtoH al pratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 111 । 98 । “juhvatAmagnihotrARi DUmarAjisamudgamEH । pradarSayadivArohamArgaM divi tapasvinAm ॥”)
v: pu॰ sam + ud + gama--GaY na vfdDiH । 1 UrdDagatO 2 samudBave ca ।
m: सम्-˚उद्गम m. going up, rising, ascending, Kāv.; Kathās.
a: समुद्गमः — 1 Rising, ascent. --2 Arising, issuing. --3 Birth, production.

m: सम्-˚उद्गत mfn. risen up, come forth, appeared, begun, Ṛtus.; Lalit.
समुद्ग—यमक n. id., Bhaṭṭ., Sch.

a: समुद्गिरणं — 1 Vomiting, ejecting. --2 That which is vomited. --3 Raising, lifting up.

k.v: प्राण्युत्पादे संसरणमसंबाधचमूगतौ। घण्टापथेऽथ वान्तान्ने समुद्गिरणमुन्नये॥
प्राण्युत्पादे संसरणमसंबाधचमूगतौ। घण्टापथेऽथ वान्तान्ने समुद्गिरणमुन्नये॥

m: सम्-उद्-√ ग्रह् P. -गृह्णाति, to raise or lift up, take hold of, seize on ŚBr.
सम्-उद्-√ ग्रन्थ् (only ind.p. -ग्रथ्य), to bind up together, tie or fasten up, MBh.
सम्-उद्-√ गुञ्ज् P. -गुञ्जति, to begin to hum, Prasannar.
सम्-उद्-√ इ P. -एति, to go upwards or rise up together, come together or prepare (for battle &c.), MBh.; to rise (as the sun), ib.
a: समुदि — {c2c} P. 1 To go up, ascend, rise. --2 To prepare for battle. --3 To collect together, assemble.

s: tri, (samyakprakAreRa kaTitaH । saMpUrvvavadaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH । udayaM prAptaH । samudBUtaH । saMpUrvvotpUrvvenaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + iR--kta । 1 prAptasaMBUtO padArTe sama + vada--karmaRi kta । 2 samyakkaTite ।
m: 1. सम्-उदित mfn. (for 2. See under सम्-उद्-√ इ) spoken to or with, addressed, accosted, BhP.
agreed upon (see यथा-समुदितम्)
consented, settled, customary, Kathās.
2. सम्-उदित mfn. (for 1. See सं-√ वद्, p. 1114, col. 2) gone up, risen, elevated, lofty, R.; Kir.
collected, gathered together, united, assembled, R.; Daś.; Siddh.
possessed of, furnished with (instr. or comp.), MBh.; R.
furnished with everything, well supplied, wanting nothing, ib.
a: समुदित — p. p. 1 Gone up, risen, ascended. --2 Lofty, elevated. --3 Produced, arisen, occasioned. --4 Assembled, collected, united; मद्भाग्योपचयादयं समुदितः सर्वो गुणानां गणः Ratn. 1. 6. --5 Possessed of, furnished with. --6 Conversed. --7 Spoken to, addressed. --8 Agreed upon. --9 Customary, usual.

m: सम्-उदितृ mfn. rising, surging (used to explain समुद्र), Nir. x, 32.
सम्-उदित्वर mfn. going up, rising, KāśīKh.

s: strI, sawI । (samyagudgato ro'gniryasyAH .) SamI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: सम्-उद्रा (आ), f. N. of two plants (= शटी and शमी), L.
समुद्राभिसारिणी f. a maiden going to meet the god of the ocean, Vikr.
समुद्रादि the 4th or other syllable in a stanza when a caesura follows, Piṅg., Sch.
समुद्राम्भस् n. sea water, MW.

s: strI, (samudraH ambaramiva yasyAH .) pfTivI । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: strI samudraHambaramiva vezwanAkAratvAt yasyAH । pfTivyAM trikA॰ । sAgarAmbarAdayI'pyatra ।
m: समुद्राम्बरा f. ‘sea-clothed’, the earth, L.

s: strI, (samudrasya antaH utpattisTAnatvenAstyasyA iti । ac । wAp .) durAlaBA । ityamaraH । 2 । 4 । 92 ॥ kArpAsI । pfkkA । iti medinI ॥ yavAsaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: समुद्रान्ता (आ), f. the earth,
the shrub Alhagi Maurorum, Bhpr.
the cotton plant, ib.
Trigonella Corniculata, ib.

k.v: रोदनी कच्छुरानन्ता समुद्रान्ता दुरालभा। पृश्निपर्णी पृथक्पर्णी चित्रपर्ण्यङ्घ्रिवल्लिका॥
तुण्डिकेरी समुद्रान्ता कार्पासी बदरेति च। भारद्वाजी तु सा वन्या शृङ्गी तु ऋषभो वृषः॥
मरुन्माला तु पिशुना स्पृक्का देवी लता लघुः। समुद्रान्ता वधूः कोटिवर्षा लङ्कोपिकेत्यपि॥

s: klI, (samudrasya anta utpattisTAnatvenAstyasyeti । ac .) jAtIPalam । iti SabdacandrikA ॥ (samudrasya antam .) samudratIram ॥ (samudraH anto rasyeti । samudrAntaviSizwe, tri । yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 47 । 33 । “etadantaH samAmnAyo yogaH sAMKyaM manIziRAm । tyAgastapo damaH satyaM samudrAntA ivApagAH ॥”)

m: समुद्रान्त m. the sea-shore, Cāṇ.
समुद्रान्त mf(आ)n. reaching to the sea (said of the earth), R.; Kathās.
falling into the sea (as a river), BhP.
समुद्रान्त n. nutmeg, L.
समुद्रार्थ mf(आ)n. tending, to the sea, RV.

also = सेतुबन्ध, L.
समुद्रावगाहन m. a partic. Samādhi, Kāraṇḍ.
समुद्रावरण mf(आ)n. sea-clothed (the earth), BhP.
समुद्रावरोहण m. a partic. Samādhi, Kāraṇḍ.
समुद्राय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to resemble the sea, appear like the ocean, Mṛcch.
समुद्रायण mf(आ)n. flowing to the sea, PraśnUp.

excessive brilliance, exhilaration, MW.
a: समुल्लासः — 1 Excessive brilliance. --2 Great joy, exhilaration.

m: सम्-उल्लासिन् mfn. shining forth, glittering, Kpr.
सम्-उल्-√ लङ्घ् (-उद्-√ लङ्घ्) P. -लङ्घयति, to leap beyond, violate, transgress, neglect, MārkP.; to carry over, transport, Hcar.
सम्-उल्-लम्बित mfn. (fr. समुद्-√ लम्ब्), hanging up, hanging, Mṛcch.

सम्-उल्-√ लस् (-उद्-√ लस्) P. -लसति, to shine forth, gleam, glitter, Śiś.; to break forth, appear, Kir.; Pañcat.; to sound, resound, Prasannar. : Caus. -लासयति, to cause to jump or sport, exhilarate, make glad, MW.
a: समुल्लस् — {c1c} P. 1 To shine forth, gleam. --2 To break forth, appear. --3 To sport, be wanton, dally.

m: सम्-उल्लसित mfn. shining forth, gleaming, brilliant, beautiful, Gīt.
sportive, sporting, W.

v: pu॰ sam + ud + liKa--GaY । pAdAdinA BUmyAdeH Kanane ।
m: सम्-उल्लेख m. digging up all round, extermination (= उत्सादन), L.
सम्-उल्-√ लिख् (-उद्-√ लिख्) P. -लिखति, to scratch up all round, dig up, ŚBr.; to scratch, furrow, Kum.; to rub against, graze, R.; to write down, mention (in a book), L.

s: [t] tri, (sam + ut + liKa + Satf .) pAdAdinA BUmiKananakarttA । yaTA, -- “tuzArasaMGAtaSilAH kzurAgrEH samulliKan darpakalaH kakudmAn । dfzwaH kaTaYcidgavayErvivignErasoQasiMhaDvanirunnanAda ॥” iti kumArasamBave । 1 । 56 ॥

m: सम्-उल्-√ लुप् (-उद्-√ लुप्) P. -लुम्पति, to seize upon, lay hold of, pick up, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.
सम्-√ उन्द् See सम्-√ उद्, p. 1166.

s: klI, (sam + unda + lyuw .) ArdrIBAvaH । tatparyyAyaH । temaH 2 stemaH 3 । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 29 ॥
m: सम्-उन्दन n. becoming thoroughly wet, moisture, wetness, L.

k.v: निपाठनिपठौ पाठे तेमस्तेमौ समुन्दने। आदीनवास्रवौ क्लेशे मेलके सङ्गसङ्गमौ॥

m: सम्-उन्-√ मील् (-उद्-√ मील्) P. -मीलति, to become fully expanded or unfolded or displayed, Amar.; Prab. : Caus. -मीलयति to open (the eyes), MBh.; R.; to expand, display, exhibit, Uttarar.
सम्-उन्मीलित mfn. opened, expanded, displayed, Prab.
सम्-उन्-√ मूल् (उद्-√ मूल्) P. -मूलयति, to uproot or eradicate completely, exterminate or destroy utterly, Rājat.; Hit.
सम्-उन्मूलन n. the act of uprooting or eradicating completely, utter destruction, extermination, Uttarar.; Prab.
a: समुन्मूलनं — Uprooting, eradication.

m: सम्-उन्-मज्ज् (-उद्-√ मज्ज् only ind.p. -मज्ज्य), to dive under, bathe, MBh.
सम्-उन्-मृज् (-उद्-√ मृज्) to rub up, MaitrS.; MānŚr.; to rub completely off or out, Kāṭh.
सम्-उन्मिश्र mfn. mixed or mingled with, accompanied by (instr.), MBh.; Hariv.
सम्-उन्-√ मिष् (-उद्-√ मिष्) P. -मिषति, to rise up, spring up from (abl.), Rājat.; to shine forth, shine bright, HYogay.
सम्-उन्मुख mfn. ‘having the face erected’, upright, high (˚खी-√ कृ, ‘to lift up’), Naiṣ.
सम्-˚उन्नाद m. simultaneous roaring or shouting, MBh.
सम्-उन्नाह m. pressing up or out, Suśr.
height, elevation, BhP.

सम्-उन्-√ नी (-उद्-√ नी) P. Ā. -नयति, ˚ते, to lead or conduct upward, together, raise completely up, elevate, increase, MBh.; BhP.; to instigate, stimulate, Kām.; to deduce, infer, Rājat.; Sāh.; to pay off (a debt), Kull. on Mn. ix, 107.
a: समुन्नी — {c1c} U. 1 To raise completely up, elevate. --2 To bring out, deduce. --3 To discharge, pay off (as a debt &c.).

m: सम्-˚उन्नीत mfn. raised up, elevated, increased, MBh.

v: na॰ sam + unda--kta । 1 klinne 2 Ardre amaraH ।
m: सम्-उन्न mfn. well moistened or sprinkled, thoroughly wet, L.
a: समुन्न — a. Wet, moist.

k.v: अन्वेषितं गवेषितमन्विष्टं मार्गितं मृगितम्. आर्द्रं सार्द्रं क्लिन्नं तिमितं स्मितितं समुन्नमुत्तं च॥

m: सम्-उन्-√ नद् (-उद्-√ नद्) P. -नदति, to cry out together, shout out, roar out, MBh.; Hariv.

s: tri, (sam + ut + naha + ktaH .) paRqitammanyaH । garvvitaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 3 । 103 ॥ praBuH । ityajayaH ॥ samudBUtaH । iti medinI ॥ UrdDvabadDaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + naha--kta । 1 garvite 2 paRqitanmanye amaraH । 3 praBO ajayaH । 4 samudDfte medi॰ 5 utkzipya badDe hemaca॰ । 6 samudBUte ca । BAve kta । 7 uttolyabanDane na॰ ।
m: सम्-उन्नद्ध mfn. tied or bound up (= ऊर्ध्व-बद्ध), L.
swollen, pressed up or out, Suśr.
raised up, elevated, exalted, Kāv.; Pur.
full, excessive, BhP.
proud, arrogant, ib.
unfettered, loosened, ib.
produced, born, L.
a: समुन्नद्ध — p. p. 1 Elevated, exalted. --2 Swollen. --3 Full. --4 Proud, arrogant, overbearing. --5 Conceited, thinking oneself to be learned. --6 Unfettered. --7 Bound up. --8 Supreme.

k.v: मधु मद्ये पुष्परसे क्षौद्रेऽप्यन्धं तमस्यपि। अतस्त्रिषु समुन्नद्धौ पण्डितम्मन्यगर्वितौ॥
मधु मद्ये पुष्परसे क्षौद्रेऽप्यन्धं तमस्यपि। अतस्त्रिषु समुन्नद्धौ पण्डितम्मन्यगर्वितौ॥

m: सम्-उन्नद m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
सम्-उन्-√ नह् (-उद्-√ नह्) P. Ā. -नह्यति, ˚ते, to bind or tie up &c. (see next).
a: समुन्नह् — {c4c} P. 1 To bind or tie up. --2 To raise or lift up. --3 To loosen, unfasten. --4 To liberate, release, set free.

m: सम्-उन्-√ नम् (-उद्-√ नम्) P. -नमति, to rise up or ascend together, rise aloft, ascend, Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -नामयति or -नमयति, to raise well up, erect, lift completely up, elevate, MBh.; Śak.; Śuśr.
a: समुन्नम् — {c1c} P. To rise, ascend. --Caus. To raise or lift up, erect.

m: सम्-उन्नमन n. raising, arching (as the brows), Sāh.
सम्-उन्नस mfn. having a prominent nose, Hariv.

s: tri, (sam + ut + nama + ktaH .) samunnadDaH । stamBaBedaH । iti DaraRiH ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + nama--kta । 1 atyucce 2 stamBamede pu॰ paraRiH
m: सम्-उन्नत mfn. risen up, lifted up, raised aloft, Kāv.
arched, vaulted, VarBṛS.; Rājat.
high, sublime, Kām.
proud, arrogant, W.
a: समुन्नत — p. p. 1 Upraised, lifted up. --2 Elevated, high, lofty. --3 Exalted, sublime. --4 Proud. --5 Projecting. --6 Upright, just.

m: सम्-उन्नत—लाङ्गुल mfn. having the tail erect, Hit. (cf. सम्-उद्धत-ल्˚).

s: strI, (sam + ut + nama + ktin .) ucCrAyaH । utseDaH । iti jawADaraH ॥ (yaTA, kumAre । 6 । 66 । “upapannamidaM sarvvamataH paramapi tvayi । manasaH SiKarARAYca sadfSI te samunnatiH ॥”)
v: tri॰ sam + ud + nama--ktin । 1 uccatAyAm “prAyaH payADarasamunnatiratra hetuH” utyudBawaH । 2 utseDe sPItayAyAM jawA॰ ।
m: सम्-˚उन्नति f. rising, swelling, Subh.
exaltation, eminence, high position, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
elevation, increase, growth (with मनसः, ‘elevation of mind’; चित्तं समुन्नतिम् अश्नुते, ‘the spirit experiences elevation’), Kālid.; Pañcat.
a: समुन्नतिः — f. 1 Lifting up, raising. --2 Height, loftiness, elevation (mental also); मनसः शिखराणां च सट्टशी ते समुन्नतिः Ku. 6. 66; R. 3. 10. --3 Eminence, high position or dignity, exaltation; उत्तमैः सह संगेन को न याति समुन्नतिं; स जातो येन जातेव याति वंशः समुन्नतिं Subhāṣ. --4 Rise, prosperity, increase, success; विनिपातोपि समः समुन्नतेः Ki. 2. 34, or प्रकृतिः खलु सा महीयसः सहते नान्यसमुन्नतिं यया 2. 21. --5 Pride, arrogance.

v: pu॰ sam + ud + nI--ac । 1 UrdDvanayane 2 samyagnItO 3 utkzepaRe 4 samudBAvane ca ।
m: सम्-उन्नय m. bringing out, inference, deduction, Cat.
occurrence, event, advent, Bhaṭṭ.
a: समुन्नयः — 1 Getting, obtaining. --2 Occurrence, event.

m: सम्-˚उन्नयन n. raising up, arching (as the brows), Daśar.
सम्-˚उन्नेय mfn. to be brought out or deduced, Sāh.
सम्-उन्निद्र mfn. wide awake, opened wide (as eyes), Dharmaś.
सम्-उपाभि-च्छाद m. (fr. √ 1. छद्), Pat. on Pāṇ. vi, 4, 96.
सम्-उपा-√ घ्रा (only ind.p. -घ्राय), to smell at, kiss, MBh.; R.
सम्-उपाश् (-उप- √ 2. अश्) P. -उपाश्नाति, to taste fully or completely, enjoy, MBh.
सम्-उपा-श्रित mfn. (√ श्रि) leaning against, supported by, resting on (acc.), MBh.; R. &c.
resorted to, one who has recourse to (acc.), ib.
occupied by (instr.), Rājat.
visited or afflicted by (instr.), MBh.
सम्-उपा-√ चर् P. -चरति, to attend, wait on, treat (medically), Suśr.; to practise, attend to, be intent upon (acc.), MBh.
सम्-उपा-√ दा Ā. -दत्ते (ind.p. -दाय, q.v.), to gain, receive, acquire, MBh.; MārkP.; to take away from, deprive of MBh.; to collect, heap together, R.; to assume, put on MBh.
सम्-उपादाय ind. having gained &c. &c.
having used or employed (with acc. = ‘with the help of’, ‘by means of’), R.
सम्-उपा-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go up to together, go near to, resort to, approach, meet, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to undergo, incur, get into any state or condition (acc.), R.
सम्-उपागत mfn. gone near to, approached, met, come, arrived, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
one who has attained, R.
one who has incurred or undergone, ib.
सम्-उपा-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to bring near, fetch, procure, MBh.; R. &c.; to offer, sacrifice, MBh.; R.; BhP.; to sacrifice one's self, Rājat.; to enter upon (initiation), R.
सम्-उपा-√ कृ P. Ā. -करोति, -कुरुते, to satisfy, pay off, MBh.
सम्-उपा-क्रान्त mfn. (√ क्रम्) one who has approached or attained to or arrived at (acc.), R.
सम्-उपालम्भ m. reproach, censure, MBh.
सम्-उपा-√ नी P. -नयति, to conduct or lead together towards, bring or gather together, assemble, R.
सम्-उपानीत mfn. brought together, gathered, assembled, MBh.
सम्-उपानयन n. bringing near, procuring, MBh.
सम्-उपारूढ mfn. mounted upon, ascended, R.
सम्-उपा-रब्ध mfn. (√ रभ्) begun, commenced, undertaken, MBh.
सम्-उपार्ज् (-उप-√ अर्ज्) Caus. -उपार्जयति, to gain or acquire together, procure, Bhpr.
सम्-उपार्जन n. the act of gaining or acquiring together, simultaneous acquisition, Mn. vii, 152.
a: समुपार्जनं — Acquiring together, simultaneous acquisition.

m: सम्-˚उपार्जित mfn. brought together, prepared, MW.
acquired, gained, ib.
stored up, ib.
सम्-उपा-√ रुह् P. -रोहति, to mount up, ascend, MBh.
सम्-उपा-√ रुज् = सम्-उप-√ रुज्

सम्-उपास् (-उप-√ आस्) Ā. -उपास्ते (pr. p. -उपासीन), to sit near together or near each other, R.; to engage in or devote one's self to anything together, practise in common (or singly), Gṛhyās.; R.; to serve or honour together, revere, worship, adore, MBh.; Mṛcch.; Ragh.
सम्-उपा-√ स्था P. Ā. -तिष्ठति, ˚ते, to stand near to, Hariv.; to practise, observe, MBh.
सम्-उपास्थित mfn. come near, approached, MBh.; R.
सम्-उपात्त mfn. gained, acquired, taken, robbed, gathered, collected, MBh.; R. &c.
सम्-उपा-√ वृ (prob.) w.r. for सम्-अपा-√ वृ (q.v.)
सम्-उपा-√ विश् P. -विशति, to enter upon together, undertake, begin, commence, R. : Caus. -वेशयति, to conceal, hide, HPariś.
सम्-उपा-√ या P. -याति, to go up to together, go or resort to (acc.), approach, meet, MBh.; Kathās.
सम्-उपायात mfn. come near, approached, arrived, Kāv.
सम्-उपा-युक्त mfn. (√ युज्) furnished with, possessed of, surrounded by, full of (instr.), MBh.
सम्-उपभोग m. enjoying, eating, MBh.
cohabitation, sexual union, MW.
a: समुपभोगः — Sexual union, coition.

m: सम्-उप-√ भुज् Ā. -भुङ्क्ते, to enjoy sexually, have sexual union with (acc.), MBh.; R.
सम्-उप-√ धा P. Ā. -दधाति, -धत्ते, to put together, construct, create, produce, MW.
सम्-उप-√ धाव् P. -धावति, to run near or towards (acc.), MBh.
सम्-उप-√ घ्रा P. -जिघ्रति, to smell at, kiss, R.
सम्-उप-√ शम् P. -साम्यति, to become quiet, cease, MBh.; Car.
सम्-उप-√ श्रु P. -सृणोति, to listen to anything (acc.), hear, hear or perceive any one (gen.), hear from or be told by any one (abl.), MBh.; R.; BhP.
सम्-उप-√ बृह् Caus. -बृंहयति, to cause to increase, augment, strengthen, complete, MBh.; VāyuP.
सम्-उपचार m. attention, homage, Pañcar.
सम्-उप-च्छाद m. (√ 1. छद्), Pāṇ. vi, 4, 96, Sch.
सम्-उप-√ चि P. -चिनोति, to heap up, gather, Nāg. : Pass. -चीयते, to grow up, increase, Suśr.

v: tri॰ samyak upacitam upa + ci--kta । 1 subahulIkfte 2 saMvardDite ca ।
m: सम्-उपचित mfn. collected, heaped, W.
abundant, Ratnāv.
thick, Car.
सम्-उपचित—जल mfn. having accumulated waters (as the ocean), MW.
सम्-उप-√ दृश् Caus. -दर्शयति, to cause to see or be seen, show, exhibit, Kāraṇḍ.
सम्-उप-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to point out or indicate fully, show, MBh.; to assign (with acc. of person and of thing), R.
सम्-उप-√ द्रु P. -द्रवति (ep. also Ā. ˚ते), to run together towards, rush upon (acc.), MBh.; R.; to run up to, assail, attack, VarBṛS.
सम्-उपद्रुत mfn. assailed, attacked, overrun, ib.
सम्-उप-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go or proceed together towards, go or come near to (acc.), approach, have recourse to, MBh.; R.; to go to any state or condition, undergo, R.; Kathās.
सम्-उपगम m. going near, approach, contact, W.
a: समुपगमः — Approach, contact.

m: सम्-उपगन्तव्य mfn. to be gone to &c.
सम्-उपगन्तव्य n. it is to be gone to &c. (अस्य विश्वासे समुपगन्तव्यम्, ‘one should place confidence in him’), Pañcat.
सम्-उपगत mfn. approached, W.
undergone, Śak.
सम्-उप-√ गुह् P. Ā. -गूहति, ˚ते, to embrace, surround, Caurap.
सम्-उप-हत mfn. (√ हन्) stricken, impaired (as reason), VarYogay.
सम्-उपहव See सम्-उप-√ ह्वे below.
सम्-उपहव m. an invitation together with others, common invitation, Br.; Lāṭy.
सम्-उप-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to bring towards, offer, R.; Jātakam.; to pay (honour), Jātakam.; to perform (a sacrifice), MW.
सम्-उपह्वर m. a hidden place, hiding-place, MBh.
सम्-उप-√ ह्वे P. Ā. -ह्वयति, ˚ते (ind.p. -हूय, or -हावम्), to call together, invite, TS.; Br.; ŚrS.; to challenge (to fight), MBh.; R.
सम्-उपजा˚ताभिनिवेशम् ind. after having formed a determined resolution, Prab.
सम्-उपजात mfn. arisen, produced, Prab.
aroused, MW.
सम्-उपजात—कोप mfn. one whose anger is roused, provoked or moved to an˚, ib.
सम्-उप-√ ज्ञा P. Ā. -जानाति, -जानीते, to ascertain fully, find out, MBh.; to perceive, learn, W.
सम्-उप-√ जन् Ā. -जायते, to arise, spring up, take place, Kāv.; to be born again, MBh. : Caus. -जनयति, to generate, cause, produce, Ṛtus.
सम्-उपजनित mfn. (fr. Caus.) generated, produced, caused, ib.

s: [m] vya, (sam + upa + juza + am .) AnandaH । ityamarawIkAyAM rAmASramaH । 3 । 4 । 10 ॥ tAlavyaSakArAdi ca ॥

v: avya॰ sam + upa + juza--amu । atyantAnande rAmASramaH ।
m: सम्-उपजोषम् ind. entirely according to wish or liking, quite contentedly (= उपज्˚, q.v.), L.
a: समुपजोषम् — ind. 1 Entirely according to wish. --2 Happily.

k.v: दिष्ट्या समुपजोषं चेत्यानन्देऽथान्तरेऽन्तरा। अन्तरेण च मध्ये स्युः प्रसह्य तु हठार्थकम्.।

m: सम्-उपकल्पित mfn. made ready, prepared, arranged, MBh.; R.
सम्-उप-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw towards at one time or together, draw near, R.
सम्-˚उपक्रान्त mfn. approached, MW.
one who has begun, R.
सम्-उप-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to go up to, approach, MW.; to begin, commence to (inf.), MBh.; R.
सम्-उपक्रम m. commencement, L.
com˚ of medical treatment, Car.
सम्-˚उपक्रम्य mfn. to be treated medically, ib.
सम्-उप-√ कॢप् Ā. -कल्पते, to be prepared or made ready together, MW. : Caus. -कल्पयति, to make ready together, prepare, make ready, accomplish, MBh.
सम्-˚उपकॢप्त mfn. prepared or made ready together, ŚāṅkhŚr.
सम्-उप-√ लभ् Ā. -लभते (ep. also P. -लभति), to take or receive fully, obtain, MBh.; R.; to acquire by experience, learn, perceive, VarBṛS.
सम्-उप-√ लक्ष् P. Ā. -लक्षयति, ˚ते, to look at or observe attentively, Kām.; to see, perceive, MBh.

सम्-उप-√ नी P. Ā. -नयति, ˚ते, to lead up to together, bring or draw near to, lead to (acc.), MBh.; Kāv.; VarBṛS.; to take away, carry off, MBh.; to offer (a sacrifice), R.; to bring about, cause, Hariv.
सम्-उपनीत mfn. brought or led to (acc.), R.
सम्-उपनयन n. the act of leading near to, Dharmaśarm.
सम्-उप-न्य्-√ अस् P. -अस्यति, to lay down fully, state at full length, Hit.
सम्-उपन्यस्त mfn. fully stated, ib.
सम्-उपपादित mfn. (fr. Caus.) made ready, prepared, ib.
सम्-उप-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते, to come to pass, be brought about or accomplished, MBh.; to meet with (acc.), experience, ib. : Caus. -पादयति, to bring about, make ready, prepare, R.
सम्-उप-प्लुत mfn. (√ प्लु) overwhelmed, assailed, distressed, R.
सम्-उप-√ रुध् P. -रुणद्धि, to hinder greatly, disturb, obstruct: Pass., -रुध्यते, to be hindered or interrupted, MBh.
सम्-उप-√ रुज् P. -रुजति, to break or cut up, MW.; to press hardly upon, Hariv.
सम्-उप-√ स्था P. Ā. -तिष्ठति, ˚ते, to stand near (at any one's service), R.; to lean on (acc.), ib.; to go to, approach (acc.), MBh.; to occur, arise, befall, Śak. : Caus. स्थापयति, to set up, Suśr.
सम्-उपस्था f. standing near, approximation, proximity, W.
happening, befalling, ib.
a: समुपस्था — {c1c} U. 1 To come near, go to, approach. --2 To attack. --3 To befall, occur. --4 To stand in close contact. --5 To attain, arrive at, resort to; Ś. 2. 10.
समुपस्था, समुपस्थानं — 1 Approach, approximation. --2 Proximity, nearness. --3 Happening, befalling, occurrence.

m: सम्-˚उपस्थान n. approximation, approach, ib.
nearness, ib.
happening, occurring, ib.
सम्-उपस्थित mf(आ)n. approximated, approached, come to (तेषाम् अग्रतो नदी समुपस्थिता = ‘they came upon a river’), MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
sitting or lying on (loc.), R.
arisen, Hariv.
appeared, begun, imminent, MBh.; Hariv.; R. &c.
seasonable, opportune, MBh.
come upon, fallen to, fallen to one's share (with acc. or gen.), Kāv.; Bhag. &c.
ready for (dat. or loc.), MBh.; BhP.
undertaken, resolved, R.
attained, acquired, W.
सम्-˚उपस्थिति f. = ˚उपस्थान above, ib.
a: समुपस्थितिः --समुपस्थानं — q. v.

m: सम्-उप-सं-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to restrain, stop (see next).
सम्-उपसंहृत mfn. restrained, stopped, Uttarar.
सम्-उप-√ सद् P. -सीदति to go to, approach (acc.), MBh.; to get at, obtain (acc.), Śiś.
सम्-उप-√ सेव् Ā. -सेवते, to make use of together, MW.; to be addicted to, enjoy, R.
सम्-उप-√ सृ P. -सरति, to come near, approach, R.
सम्-उप-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to go to (acc.), approach, MBh.; R.; Bālar.; to attack, MW.
सम्-उप-√ स्पृश् P. -स्पृशति, to touch, R.; to touch (water for ablution), touch with water (instr.), bathe in (loc.), MBh.; Yājñ.; to sip water, MW.
सम्-उपस्तम्भ m. propping, supporting, MBh.
a support, Car.
सम्-उप-√ तप् Pass. -तप्यते, to feel pain, MBh.
सम्-उप-√ वह् P. -वहति, to bear or carry along with, flow with, MBh. : Pass. -उपोह्यते, to be borne near, approach, Hariv.
सम्-उप-√ वस् P. -वसति, to abide wholly in, engage in, devote one's self to (see below); to abide in a state of abstinence, fast, Hcat.
सम्-उपवेश m. sitting down together, MW.
inviting any one to sit down or rest, entertaining, W.
a seat, Uttarar.
a: समुपवेशः — 1 Sitting down together. --2 Entertaining.

m: सम्-˚उपवेशन n. the act of causing to sit down, MW.
a habitation, building, ib.
a seat, Uttarar.
a: समुपवेशनं — 1 A building, habitation, residence. --2 Seating down.

m: सम्-˚उपवेशित mfn. made to sit down, invited to rest, W.
सम्-उप-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to go together towards, proceed together, MW.; to behave, R.

सम्-उप-√ विश् P. -विशति, to sit down together or near, sit down on (loc. acc., or gen. with उपरि), ŚBr.; GṛŚrS.; ChUp. &c.; to lie down upon (acc.), ib.; to encamp, ib.; to oversleep (the right time for anything), R. : Caus. -वेशयति, to cause to sit down, ask to be seated, Hit.; to cause to encamp, Rājat.
a: समुपविश् — {c6c} P. 1 To sit down. --2 To lie down upon. --3 To encamp.

m: सम्-˚उपविष्ट mfn. seated, sat down, MBh.; Pañcat. &c.
सम्-उप-√ या P. -याति, to go up to or approach (with acc.), R.; to betake one's self to (acc.), MBh.; VarBṛS.; to go to any state or condition (with acc.), VarBṛS.
सम्-उपयात mfn. gone up to, approached (with acc.), ib.
सम्-उपयोषम् ind. = समुपजोषम्, col. 1.
सम्-उप-√ युज् P. -युनक्ति, to make complete use of, consume, MBh. : Caus. -योजयति id., ib.
सम्-उपयुक्त mfn. completely used up or consumed, eaten, MW.
सम्-˚उपयुक्त-वत् mfn. one who has consumed, MBh.
सम्-उपष्टम्भ m. = सम्-उपस्तम्भ below, MBh.

सम्-उपे (-उप- √ 5. इ) -उपैति, to come together, meet (as friends or foes), MBh.; R.; Pañcat.; to have sexual intercourse, MBh.; to come near, approach, go to (acc.), ib. ; to have recourse to, apply to, ŚārṅgP.; to attain, incur, partake of VarBṛS.; Śiś.; to occur, happen, appear, MBh.; to come upon, befall, R.; to be absorbed in RPrāt.
a: समुपे — {c2c} P. 1 To get, obtain. --2 To assemble, meet. --3 To attack, assail. --4 To go to, reach. --5 To fall to the lot of. --6 To undergo, suffer.

m: सम्-उपेक्ष् (-उप-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -उपेक्षते (ep. also ˚ति), to look completely over or beyond, take no notice of, disregard, neglect, abandon, MBh.; Mṛcch.; Amar.
सम्-उपेक्षक mfn. overlooking, not heeding, disregarding, neglecting (gen.), BhP.
सम्-उपेप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid. of सम्-उप-√ आप्) wishing to obtain, striving after (acc.), Kāv.
सम्-उपेत mfn. come together &c. &c.
come, arrived, MBh.
furnished or supplied with, abounding in (instr. or comp.), ib.
a: समुपेत — p. p. 1 Come together, assembled, collected. --2 Arrived at. --3 Furnished or endowed with, possessed of. --4 Inhabited by.

s: [s] tri, gamanakarttA । gamanaviSizwaH । samupapUrvveDAtoH kvasupratyayena nizpannaH ॥

v: tri॰ sam + upa + vaha--kta । 1 saNgate 2 saYjAte ca ।
m: सम्-उपोढ See p. 1170, col. 2.
सम्-उपोढ mfn. (√ 1. ऊह्) brought near, presented, offered, Mn. vi, 41
commenced, begun (as a battle), R. (also -उपो|अ, ĀśvGṛ.)
risen (as the moon), Uttarar.
a: समुपोढ — p. p. 1 Gone upwards, risen; U. 5. 26. --2 Increased. --3 Brought near. --4 Restrained. --5 Begun.

m: सम्-उपोप-विष्ट mfn. (cf. उपोप [for उप-उप] -√ विश्) seated together, sitting down, Hariv. 7042.
सम्-उपोष् (-उप-√ उष्) P. -उपोषति, to burn or consume together, burn up completely, ŚBr.
सम्-उपोषक mfn. fasting, Kṛṣṇaj.
सम्-˚उपोषित mf(आ)n. engaged in, devoted to (acc.), MārkP.
one who has fasted, MBh.; VarBṛS.; BhP.
सम्-उत्-√ खन् P. Ā. -खनति, ˚ते (ind.p. -खाय), to dig up by the roots, Kauś.; to eradicate, exterminate or destroy utterly, Prab.; to draw forth, draw (a sword), Prasannar.
सम्-उत्फाल m. a jump, canter, gallop, L.
सम्-उत्फुल्ल mfn. (having the eyes) opened wide, Kād.

सम्-उत्-था (-उद्-√ स्था) P. Ā. -तिष्ठति, ˚ते, to rise up together, Jātakam.; to rise up (as from death), get up (from sleep &c.), ŚBr.; MBh. &c.; to recover (from sickness), Car.; to rise (in the sky), gather (as clouds), MBh.; Kathās.; to come forth, spring from (abl.), appear, become visible, ŚBr. &c. &c.; to arise for action, prepare for or to (loc. or inf.), MBh.; VarBṛS. : Caus. -थापयति to cause to rise together, lift or raise up, elevate, MBh.; R.; BhP.; to awaken, excite, arouse, R.; Jātakam.
a: समुत्था — {c1c} P. 1 To stand up, rise. --2 To rise from death or insensibility, return to life or consciousness. --3 To rise together with. --4 To arise or spring from. --Caus. 1 To raise up, lift up, elevate. --2 To revive, restore to life.

s: klI, (sam + ut + sTA + lyuw .) samudyogaH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 32 । 7 । “sarvvehi svaM samutTAnamupajIvanti jantavaH । api DAtA viDAtA ca yaTAyamudake vakaH ॥”) vyADInAM nirRayaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 8 । 287 । “aNgAvapIqanAyAYca vraRaSoRitayostaTA । samutTAnavyayaM dApyaH sarvvadaRqamaTApi vA ॥”) UrdDvagamanam । samyakprakAreRa utTAnam ॥ uttolanam । yaTA, -- “indraDvajasamutTAnaM pramAdAnna kftaM yadi । tadA dbAdaSame varze karttavyaM nAntarA punaH ॥” iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: na॰ sam + ud + sTA--karaRe lyuw masya TaH । 1 samudyoge 2 uttAlane 3 vyADimirRaye ca medi॰ ।
m: सम्-उत्थान n. (ifc. f(आ). ) the act of rising up together, getting up, R.
hoisting (of a flag), Tithyād.
recovering from sickness or injury, MBh.
healing, cure, Mn.; Yājñ.
swelling (of the abdomen), R.
augmentation, increase, growth (of property), Yājñ.
rise, origin (ifc. = ‘rising or springing from’), Suśr.; Hariv.; Kāv.
performance of work, active operation, effort, industry (एकी-स्˚ or सम्भूय-स्˚ ‘common enterprise’, ‘co-operation’, ‘partnership’, Mn. viii, 4), Mn.; Kām.; MBh.; R.
indication or symptom of disease, L.
a: समुत्थानं — 1 Rising, getting up. --2 Resurrection. --3 Perfect cure, complete recovery. --4 Healing (as of a wound); Ms. 8. 287; Y. 2. 222. --5 A symptom of disease. --6 Engaging in industry, active occupation; as in संभूयसमुत्थानं Ms. 8. 4. --7 Increase or growth.

m: सम्-उत्थान—व्यय m. the expense of recovery or cure, Mn. viii, 287.
सम्-˚उत्थापक mfn. (fr. Caus.) rousing up, awakening, stirring, Buddh.
सम्-˚उत्थाप्य mfn. (fr. id.) to be raised or elevated, VarBṛS.

s: tri, (samuttizWatIti । saM + ut + sTA + kaH .) samudBavaH । samutTitaH । samutpUrvvasTADAtorqapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 7 । 45 । “daSa kAmasamutTAni taTAzwO kroDajAni ca । vyasanAni durantAni prayatnena vivarjjayet ॥”)
v: tri॰ samyaguttizWati sam + ud + sTA--ka sasya TaH । 1 samyagutpanne 2 utTite ca ।
m: सम्-उत्थ mf(आ)n. rising up, risen, appearing, occurring in, occasioned by, sprung or produced or derived from (comp., rarely abl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: समुत्थ — a. 1 Rising, getting up. --2 Sprung or produced from, born from (at the end of comp.); अथ नयनसमुत्थं ज्योतिरत्रेरिव द्योः R. 2. 75; Bg. 7. 27. --3 Occurring, occasioned.

m: सम्-˚उत्थेय n. (impers.) it is to be risen (for action), MBh.

s: puM, (sam + ut + sTA + ktaH .) samyagutTitaH । yaTA, -- “samutTitastvaM SravaRAdyapAde gfhARa pUjAM Bagavannamaste ॥” iti tiTyAditattve SakrotTAnapUjAmantraH ॥
m: सम्-उत्थित mfn. risen up together, risen, raised (as dust), towering above (as a peak), surging (as waves), gathered (as clouds), MBh.; Kāv. &c. appeared, grown, sprung or obtained or derived from (abl. or comp.; धनं दण-समुत्थितम्, ‘money derived from fines’), ŚvetUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
ready, prepared for (loc.), MBh.; R.; BhP.
one who withstands all (opponents), R.
cured, healed, W.
swollen up, MW.
a: समुत्थित — p. p. 1 Risen, raised. --2 Recovered, cured. --3 Arisen, produced, born.

m: सम्-उत See तर्द्म-स्˚.
सम्-उत्-कीर्ण mfn. (√ कॄ) completely perforated or pierced, Ragh.
सम्-उत्क mfn. desirous of, longing for (comp.), Kathās.
सम्-उत्कण्ठा f. wish or longing for (comp.), Vās.
सम्-उत्कण्ठ Nom. Ā. -उत्कण्ठते, to think of regretfully, pine or long after, Sāh.
सम्-उत्कण्टकित mfn. having the hair (of the body) bristling or thrilled with joy or passion, Kād.
सम्-उत्कच mfn. beginning to bloom, blooming, expanded, Pañcar.
सम्-उत्कम्पिन् mfn. trembling vehemently, Jātakam.
सम्-उत्कर्ष m. self-elevation, setting one's self up (as belonging to a higher rank than one's own tribe), Mn. xi, 55
pre-eminence, excellence, MBh.; Bhar.
laying aside (a girdle), MBh.
a: समुत्कर्षः — 1 Exaltation. --2 Setting oneself up, belonging to a tribe higher than his own; Ms. 11. 56.

m: सम्-उत्कट mfn. high, elevated, sublime, KāśīKh.
(ifc.) richly furnished with, Jātakam.
सम्-उत्-√ कृत् (only ind. -कृत्य), to cut off or out completely, MBh.
सम्-उत्-√ कृष् P. -कर्षति, to draw or raise well up, elevate, MBh.; to draw tight (the bowstring), BhP.
सम्-उत्क्लेश m. great uneasiness or disturbance, Car.
सम्-उत्-क्लिष्ट mfn. (√ क्लिश्) greatly distressed or disturbed, very uneasy or uncomfortable, Suśr.
सम्-उत्-√ क्रम् P. Ā. -क्रामति, -क्रमते, to go upwards, depart (from life), NādabUp.; to overstep, transgress, violate, MBh.
a: समुत्क्रम् — {c1c} P. 1 To violate, neglect, omit. --2 To ascend, rise.

v: pu॰ sam + Wad + krama--GaY na vfdDiH । 1 UrdDvagamane 2 samyagudgamane ।
m: सम्-उत्क्रम m. going upwards, rise, ascent, W.
transgressing proper bounds, MW.
a: समुत्क्रमः — 1 Rising upwards, ascent. --2 Transgression of proper bounds.

s: puM, (samutkroSatIti । saM + ut + kruSa + ac .) kurarapakzI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (BAve GaY .) uccEHSabdaSca ॥
v: puMstrI॰ samyam utkroSati uccEH SabdAyate sam + ud + kruSa--ac । 1 kuraravihage Sabdaca॰ striyAM NIz । BAve GaY । 2 atyuccEHSabde
m: सम्-उत्क्रोश m. crying out aloud, clamour, MW.
an osprey, L.
a: समुत्क्रोशः — 1 Crying aloud. --2 A loud uproar. --3 An osprey.

m: सम्-उत्-क्रुष्ट mfn. (√ क्रुश्) cried out, called out, R.
सम्-उत्क्षेप m. throwing in (a word), allusion to (dat.), MBh. ii, 2513.
सम्-˚उत्क्षेपण n. the altitude above the horizon (opp. to नामन), Gol.
सम्-उत्-√ क्षिप् P. Ā. -क्षिपति, ˚ते, to throw or raise or lift up, MBh.; Pañcat.; MārkP.; to throw or scatter about, throw aside, loosen, R.; to liberate, Pañcat.; to waste, destroy, R.
सम्-उत्पाद m. rise, origin, production, Sarvad.
सम्-˚उत्पादन n. (fr. Caus.) the act of bringing forth, producing, effecting, W.
a: समुत्पादनं — Effecting, accomplishing, producing.

m: सम्-˚उत्पाद्य mfn. to be produced or caused, Pañcat.
सम्-उत्पात m. a portent (boding some calamity), MBh.; Ragh.

v: pu॰ sam + ud + ca॰ pawa--ac । unmUlIkaraRe ।
m: सम्-उत्पाट m. tearing out or away, severing, detaching, W.
a: समुत्पाटः — 1 Eradication. --2 Detaching, severing, disjoining.

m: सम्-˚उत्पाटित mfn. torn completely out or away, uprooted, detached, ib.
सम्-उत्-पीडन n. (√ पीड्) the act of pressing together, great pressure or distress, Dhūrtas.

सम्-उत्-√ पद् Ā. -पद्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to spring up together, be brought forth or born of (loc.), arise, appear, occur, take place, happen, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -पादयति, to cause to arise, produce, effect, cause, MBh.; R.; Pur.
a: समुत्पद् — {c4c} A. 1 To happen, take place, occur. --2 To arise, spring up. --3 To present oneself. --Caus. To cause, effect, produce.

s: tri, (sam + ut + pada + ktaH .) samudBUtaH । yaTA, -- “pustakasTA ca yA vidyA parahastagataM Danam । kAryyakAle samutpanne na sA vidyA na tadDanam ॥” iti cARakyam ॥
m: सम्-उत्पन्न mfn. sprung up together, arisen, produced, begotten by (abl.) or on (loc.), occurred, happened, taking place, Mn.; MBh. &c.

सम्-उत्-√ पत् P. -पतति, to fly up together, spring up, ascend, rise (as the sun, clouds &c.), AV. &c. &c.; to rush upon, attack, assail, Kām.; to rush out of, burst forth, MBh.; to arise, appear, ib.; to fly away, depart, disappear, Pañcat. : Desid. See below.
a: समुत्पत् — {c1c} P. 1 To jump or spring up, rise, ascend. --2 To arise, spring from. --3 To rush out of, gush out. --4 To rush or break forth. --5 To attack, assail. --6 To depart, disappear; Pt. 1. 197.

m: सम्-उत्पतन n. the act of flying up together, rising, ascending, Pañcat.
making effort, energy, exertion, W.
a: समुत्पतनं — 1 Flying, ascending. --2 Effort, exertion.

m: सम्-उत्पतित mfn. flown up together, sprung up, risen, appeared, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP.
flown away, departed, gone, Pañcat.
exerted, vigorous, W.
सम्-˚उत्पतिष्णु mfn. desirous of standing or rising up, Harav.
सम्-उत्पत्ति f. rising together, rise, birth, origin, Mn.; MBh. &c.
a: समुत्पत्तिः — f. 1 Production, birth, origin. --2 Occurrence.

m: सम्-उत्-√ पट् P. -पाटयति, to tear completely out or up, uproot, detach, sever, MBh.; R.; Kathās.; to expel, dethrone, Rājat.
a: समुत्पट् — {c10c} U. 1 To tear completely out, root up, eradicate. --2 To sever, detach. --3 To expel, drive out of.

m: सम्-उत्-√ पृ Caus. -पारयति, to spread out, stretch forth, MW.

a: समुत्पिंज, समुत्पिंजल — a. Excessively confused or bewildered, disorganized. --जः, --लः 1 An army in great disorder. --2 Great confusion.

s: tri, (mam + ut + piji hiMsAyAm + ac .) atyantavyAkulaH । yaTA, -- “utpiYjalasamutpiYjapiYjalA BfSamAkule ॥” iti hemacandraH ॥
puM, (sam + ut + piYja + pacAdyac .) BfSamAkulasEnyam । ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 99 ॥
v: tri॰ sam + ud + piYja--aca । 1 atyAkule hemaca॰ 2 AkalasEnye pu॰ amaraH ।
m: सम्-उत्पिञ्ज mfn. excessively confused or confounded, bewildered, disturbed, L.
सम्-उत्पिञ्ज m. complete confusion, MBh. vii, 8514.

k.v: चूर्णे क्षोदः समुत्पिञ्जपिञ्जलौ भृशमाकुले। पताका वैजयन्ती स्यात्केतनं ध्वजमस्त्रियाम्.।

m: सम्-उत्पिञ्जल (W.) and सम्-उत्पिञ्˚जलक (MBh.), m. id.
सम्-उत्पिपतिषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) about to start or spring up, Kir.
सम्-उत्-पिष्ट mfn. (√ पिष्) crushed or squeezed together, greatly crushed, Suśr.
सम्-उत्-√ प्लु Ā. -प्लवते, to jump or leap up together, move by jumps, Bhaṭṭ.
सम्-उत्-पुंसन n. (see √ पुंस् and उत्पुंसय) wiping away, removing, destroying, Alaṃkārav.
सम्-उत्साह m. energy, force of will, MBh.; Suśr.
सम्-उत्साह—ता f. id. (with दाने, ‘alacrity in giving, great liberality’), Cāṇ.
सम्-˚उत्सारण n. the act of driving away &c., Kād.; Vās.
a: समुत्सारणं — 1 Driving away. --2 Pursuing, hunting.

m: सम्-उत्सारक mfn. driving away, dispelling, Hcar.
सम्-उत्-√ सद् Caus. -सादयति, to destroy utterly, overturn, overthrow, MBh.; R.

emission (of semen; ˚गं-√ कृ with loc., ‘to have sexual intercourse with’), Kull.
a: समुत्सर्गः — 1 Abandoning, leaving. --2 Shedding or casting forth, giving away. --3 Discharge of feces, voiding of excrement; Ms. 4. 50.

m: सम्-उत्सर्पण n. getting along, proceeding, being accomplished, Inscr.
सम्-उत्सव m. a great festival or festivity, R.

m: सम्-उत्-√ सृ Caus. -सारयति, to send away, dismiss, MBh.; to drive away, disperse, dispel, Kād.; Hcar.; Prab.

सम्-उत्-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to glide or soar upwards together, to rise up to (acc.), Ragh.; to rise, set in, begin (as darkness), Amar. (v.l.)
सम्-उत्सृष्ट mfn. altogether poured or shed forth, given away, wholly given up or abandoned, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-उत्-सिक्त mfn. (√ sic) overflowing with, proud of (comp.), MBh.; R.

m: सम्-उत्सुक—ता f. desire, longing, Daś.

= prec. Ṛtus.

सम्-उत्तार m. passing over safely, deliverance from (comp.), Divyāv.

सम्-उत्तीर्ण mfn. come forth from, escaped from, passed through, crossed, landed, Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
broken through, MBh. vii, 5219.
सम्-उत्तर n. = उत्तर, answer, reply, Sāh.
सम्-उत्तेजक mfn. exciting, stimulating, SaddhP.
सम्-˚उत्तेजन n. the act of exciting or inflaming greatly, Mudr.
सम्-˚उत्तेजित mfn. (fr. Caus.) greatly excited or inflamed or irritated, W.
सम्-उत्-√ तिज् Caus. -तिजयति, to excite, fire with enthusiasm, Divyāv.

passed, spent (as time), ib.

स-मुष्क mfn. having testicles, uncastrated, Baudh.
सम्-उष्यल mf(आ)n. (fr. सम् + √ उष् = वश्) desirous, loving or exciting love, AV.
